title: Sector: A module specific to this distribution doesn't sufficiently sanitize media names, potentially leading to an XSS exploit. (CVE-2026-107260)
description: Sector, a Drupal distribution, contains a vulnerability in a module that insufficiently sanitizes media names, which could allow cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks. Exploitation requires the attacker to have permissions to create or edit media entities. The vulnerability affects versions prior to 10.3.3 and versions from 10.4.0 up to but not including 10.4.2. A patch is available to address this issue.
aiSummary: The Sector Drupal distribution includes a module that does not properly sanitize media names, leading to a potential XSS vulnerability (CVE-2026-107260). This flaw allows attackers with media creation or editing privileges to inject malicious scripts via media names. The vulnerability affects versions before 10.3.3 and versions 10.4.0 through 10.4.1. A fix has been released to remediate the issue.
aiImpact: An attacker with the ability to create or edit media entities can exploit this vulnerability to execute cross-site scripting attacks. This could lead to unauthorized script execution in the context of users viewing the affected media names, potentially compromising user sessions or site integrity. However, the requirement for specific permissions limits the scope of exploitation.
